get.summary: Verify that the provided access key is valid

get.description: Returns daily and monthly credit history plus the current balance for the authenticated organization.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of recent UTC days to return.

platform.description: Credits by platform. Empty until platform usage is attributed.

dailyUsage.description: Daily credit history, oldest first, including zero days.

post.summary: Create a brand to track
post.description: Creates a brand: the entity you track across Google and AI models. Stores its aliases, tracked engines, prompts, competitors, and keywords. Free, no credits.

get.description: Returns all brands for the organization. Free, no credits.

put.description: Stores a keyword list on the brand so rank and keyword endpoints can pull it by brandId instead of re-sending keywords each call. Free, no credits.

get.description: Aggregates a brand's stored snapshots into a daily timeline per engine: checks run, times mentioned, mention rate, average position, share of voice, and sentiment breakdown. Free.

get.summary: Visibility overview rollup for a brand
get.description: A single rollup of a brand's stored snapshots for a dashboard overview: coverage, average position, share of voice, sentiment split, a per-engine breakdown, and the most-mentioned competitors. Free.

post.summary: Google rank and AI Overview presence for a keyword
post.description: Returns where a domain ranks in Google organic results for a keyword, and whether it appears in the Google AI Overview. Pass a domain, or a brandId to use the brand's domain.

brandId.description: Use a saved brand's domain instead of passing one. When set and domain is omitted, the brand's domain is used.

post.summary: Search volume and metrics for a list of keywords
post.description: Returns monthly search volume, CPC, and competition for each keyword. Pass a list of keywords, or a brandId to use the brand's saved keywords. Costs 1 credit per keyword, with a minimum of 20 credits per call.

brandId.description: Pull the keyword list from a saved brand instead of sending it inline. When set and keywords are omitted, the brand's saved keywords are used.

post.summary: Related keyword ideas for a seed keyword
post.description: Returns keywords related to a seed keyword, each with search volume, CPC, competition, and search intent. By default (mode 'suggestions') it returns keywords that contain the seed phrase, the most on-topic set. Use 'related' for semantically related searches, or 'ideas' for a broad category-based set. Costs 3 credits.

mode.description: How to expand the seed. 'suggestions' (default) returns keywords that contain the seed phrase, the most on-topic. 'related' returns semantically related searches. 'ideas' returns a broad category-based set.

post.summary: AI search volume for a list of keywords
post.description: Returns how often each keyword is searched inside AI assistants, with a monthly trend. Costs 2 credits per keyword.

post.summary: Check whether AI models mention a brand for a prompt
post.description: Runs a prompt across the selected AI engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and reports whether the brand is mentioned, its position, competitors named alongside it, and a coverage / share-of-voice / sentiment rollup. Costs 3 credits per engine (+1 per engine when sentiment is enabled).

competitors.description: Competitor names to detect alongside your brand. Enables `competitors_found` per engine and the `share_of_voice` rollup.

sentiment.description: Classify how each engine that mentions the brand portrays it (positive/neutral/negative). Adds 1 credit per engine.

brandId.description: Optional saved brand id. When set, the result is stored as a snapshot for history and timeline queries.

models.description: Optional per-engine model override, e.g. { "chatgpt": "gpt-4o" }. See GET /v1/models for the supported models per engine. Defaults are used for engines you omit.

post.summary: Run a prompt across AI models and get their answers
post.description: Sends one prompt to the selected AI engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and returns each model's full answer plus the sources it cited. Optionally pick the model per engine with `models`. Costs 3 credits per engine.

models.description: Optional per-engine model override, e.g. { "chatgpt": "gpt-4o" }. See GET /v1/models for the supported models per engine.

get.summary: List the AI models available per engine
get.description: Returns the models you can choose per engine on the visibility, prompt, and scan endpoints, plus each engine's default. Pass a chosen model through the `models` field on those endpoints. Free, no credits.
Returns stored visibility snapshots for the organization, filterable by brand, engine, prompt, mention, and date range. Free. Snapshots are created when a visibility check is run with a brandId.

post.summary: Schedule a recurring visibility scan for a brand
post.description: Creates a tracker that re-runs a saved brand's prompts across its AI engines on a schedule, saving a snapshot each time for history and alerts. Managing trackers is free; each scheduled run spends 3 credits per engine per prompt.

prompts.description: Override the brand's prompts for this tracker (empty = use the brand's).

engines.description: Override the brand's engines for this tracker (empty = use the brand's).

models.description: Optional per-engine model override, e.g. { "chatgpt": "gpt-4o" }. See GET /v1/models for supported models. Defaults are used for engines you omit.

captureSentiment.description: Classify sentiment on each run. Adds 1 credit per engine per prompt.

get.description: Returns all trackers for the organization. Free.

models.description: Optional per-engine model override, e.g. { "chatgpt": "gpt-4o" }. See GET /v1/models for supported models. Defaults are used for engines you omit.

post.summary: Run a tracker now
post.description: Enqueues an immediate scan for the tracker (in addition to its schedule). The scan spends credits when it runs. Returns queued=false if the job queue is not configured.

post.summary: Start a bulk AI visibility scan
post.description: Runs a grid of prompts × engines as a background job. Returns a scan id immediately (status 'pending'); poll GET /v1/scans/:id until 'completed'. Costs 5 credits per check (prompts × engines), +1 per check with sentiment. Charged upfront.

engines.description: Async-capable engines only (chatgpt, claude, gemini). Perplexity has no async mode — use /v1/visibility for it.

brandId.description: Optional saved brand id. Completed checks are stored as snapshots for history and timeline.

models.description: Optional per-engine model override, e.g. { "chatgpt": "gpt-4o" }. See GET /v1/models for supported models. Defaults are used for engines you omit.

get.description: Returns the organization's recent scans, newest first. Free.

get.summary: Get a scan's status and results
get.description: Returns a scan's status, progress, and per-check results. Polling this advances the scan — it fetches any newly-ready checks from DataForSEO. Poll until `done` is true. Free.

get.summary: Visibility change alerts from your trackers
get.description: Returns the change events your trackers detected between scheduled runs — when your brand is dropped from or added to a prompt, its position moves, a competitor newly appears, or sentiment shifts. Poll this to react to visibility changes. Free.

post.summary: Actionable recommendations to improve AI visibility
post.description: Analyzes a saved brand's stored visibility snapshots and returns prioritized, actionable recommendations — the prompts you're missing where competitors appear, negative-sentiment topics, weak engines, and your biggest competitive threat. Free (reads data you already collected). Run visibility checks or a tracker first to build up snapshots.

get.description: Lists the email and webhook notifications that deliver tracker alerts (visibility changes). Free.

post.summary: Create a notification subscription
post.description: Create an email or webhook notification for tracker alerts. Email notifications take one or more recipients; webhook notifications get a signing secret. Free.

brandId.description: Scope to one brand, or null for every brand.

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS URL that receives signed alert payloads.

post.summary: Rotate a webhook's signing secret
Send a test alert to a subscription
post.description: Delivers a sample alert to this subscription's channel so you can verify the setup. Free.

post.summary: Backlink profile summary for a domain
post.description: Returns a domain's backlink profile: total backlinks, referring domains, domain rank (authority), spam score, broken links, and a breakdown by link type and country. Costs 8 credits.

target.description: Domain, subdomain, or URL to analyze (e.g. 'stripe.com').

post.summary: Organic search overview for a domain
post.description: Returns a domain's organic search footprint: how many keywords it ranks for, estimated monthly organic traffic, position distribution (top 3/10/20/100), and how its rankings are moving. Pass a domain, or a brandId to use the brand's domain. Costs 5 credits.

brandId.description: Use a saved brand's domain instead of passing one. When set and domain is omitted, the brand's domain is used.

post.summary: Keywords a domain ranks for in Google
post.description: Returns the keywords a domain currently ranks for in Google organic search, each with its position, search volume, CPC, difficulty, estimated traffic value, and the ranking URL. Pass a domain, or a brandId to use the brand's domain. Results are ordered by estimated traffic value. Costs 10 credits.

brandId.description: Use a saved brand's domain instead of passing one. When set and domain is omitted, the brand's domain is used.

post.summary: On-page SEO audit for a URL
post.description: Runs an instant on-page SEO audit of a single URL and returns its on-page score, the specific issues found (missing title, no H1, broken links, render-blocking resources, and more), meta summary, and load timing. Costs 2 credits.

url.description: The full page URL to audit (e.g. 'https://example.com/pricing').

post.summary: Real AI answers that mention a brand
post.description: Finds the actual AI answers (Google AI Overviews or ChatGPT) where a brand is mentioned, including the user question that triggered them, the answer text, cited sources, and other brands named. Costs 35 credits.

domain.description: The brand's domain (e.g. 'polar.sh'). Strongly recommended — scopes results to answers that actually cite your site, which disambiguates common-word brand names. Without it, matching falls back to the brand name in the answer text.

platform.description: Which AI surface to search. `google` = Google AI Overviews (all locales). `chat_gpt` = ChatGPT (US + English only).

scope.description: Where in the AI response to look for the brand.

post.summary: Month-by-month AI mention history for a brand
post.description: Returns roughly the last 13 months of how often a brand is mentioned in AI answers, with the AI search volume behind those mentions. Use it to chart whether your AI visibility is trending up or down. Costs 35 credits.

domain.description: The brand's domain (e.g. 'polar.sh'). Strongly recommended — scopes results to answers that actually cite your site, which disambiguates common-word brand names. Without it, matching falls back to the brand name in the answer text.

post.summary: Pages and domains AI models cite about a brand
post.description: Returns the pages (or domains) most frequently cited as sources by AI answers that mention a brand, with each source's mention count. `total_mentions` is the brand's whole citation corpus; `share` is each source's slice of that corpus (small when the corpus is large), while `share_of_returned` is its slice of just the sources returned here. Reveals which content is shaping what AI says about you. Costs 35 credits.

domain.description: The brand's domain (e.g. 'polar.sh'). Strongly recommended — scopes to answers that cite your site, disambiguating common-word brand names.

group_by.description: Return the most-cited individual `pages` or aggregate them by `domains`.

platform.description: `google` = Google AI Overviews (all locales). `chat_gpt` = ChatGPT (US + English only).

post.summary: SERP competitors for a set of keywords
post.description: Returns the domains competing for the given keywords in Google search, ranked by visibility, with average position and estimated traffic value. Costs 5 credits.
